name: StarConvex.preimage_add_right
statement: StarConvex 𝕜 (z + x) s) : StarConvex 𝕜 x ((fun x => z + x) ⁻¹' s)

name: StarConvex.affinity
statement: StarConvex 𝕜 x s) (z : E) (c : 𝕜) : StarConvex 𝕜 (z + c • x) ((fun x => z + c • x) '' s)

name: starConvex_iff_div
statement: StarConvex 𝕜 x s ↔ ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → ∀ ⦃a b : 𝕜⦄, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → 0 < a + b → (a / (a + b)) • x + (b / (a + b)) • y ∈ s
